research_question: Does timely upward chip-cost migration add net return only when price, market and leave-one-out sector demand confirm absorption and all three seller models agree?

prior_evidence.hypothesis_generation_note: The earlier cost-migration point estimate was positive but failed its confidence, stale-state and placebo gates. This interaction study is a separate training-only hypothesis, not a reversal or relabeling of that result.

mechanism_parameters.adjacency: exactly one coordinate moves by one registered level

rationale.cost_migration_floor_vol: Tests whether the estimated cost center rises by a material fraction of recent volatility; sign is fixed by the absorption mechanism.
rationale.seller_model_disagreement_cap_atr: Represents observability uncertainty across the three seller hypotheses; lower disagreement is always preferred.
rationale.overhead_distance_cap_atr: Represents remaining supply above price; the scale is in ATR so it is comparable across stocks.

evaluation.outcome: net return through the twentieth market session after a real next-window fill
evaluation.costs: fees, slippage, impact and blocked-exit persistence already included
evaluation.primary_statistic: weekly-block-bootstrap lower 95 percent bound of mean net return

robust_selection.rank_within_component: maximize the minimum evaluation-fold mean, then minimize disagreement cap and overhead cap

promotion_blockers: No result from 2020-2022 may be called OOS or used for live trading.
2023 has been physically accessed and cannot be restored as an untouched holdout.
2024-2026 history is excluded from parameter selection in this protocol.
At least 52 prospective weeks beginning 2026-08-25 are required before promotion review.
Kelly, EdgeCard and live execution remain disabled unless true OOS calibration and all risk gates pass.
